# §6.0 state×event tables — GENERATED by tools/fsmgen.py

Source: `schema/lifecycle_fsm.yaml`. fsmgen's doc==artifact
comparison diffs the cell content against the design doc's inline
tables (normalized) on every run — enforced by the repo gate and
by .github/workflows/verify.yml, so the two cannot drift apart
silently.

## Section B — foreign door-0 hold machine

| State | Event | Next | epoch effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| — | `observe_delta` | HELD_FOREIGN (created) | none |
| *any state incl. RELEASED/STANDING* | `observe_delta` (same `source_delivery_id`) | unchanged — idempotent no-op | none |
| HELD_FOREIGN · STANDING | `observe_delta` (NEW `source_delivery_id`, same delta tuple) | unchanged — delivery recorded on the open hold | none |
| HELD_FOREIGN | `actor_verified_match(subject, actor_node_id)` — SEPARATED + `VERIFIED_API` only | RELEASED(`ACTOR_VERIFIED_AUTO`) | as ACCEPT_OURS |
| HELD_FOREIGN | `operator_reconcile(accepting d)` | RELEASED(d) | per d |
| HELD_FOREIGN | `operator_reconcile(REJECT_RESTORE_HOLD)` | HELD_FOREIGN (assessment recorded) | none |
| HELD_FOREIGN | `operator_reconcile(STANDING)` | STANDING | none |
| STANDING | `operator_reconcile(d)` | as the HELD_FOREIGN rows — re-enterable | per d |
| RELEASED(d) | `operator_reconcile(d)` — same d | RELEASED(d) — identity (idempotent replay) | none |
| RELEASED(d) | `operator_reconcile(d′ ≠ d)` | ILLEGAL ⇒ typed error | — |
| RELEASED | — | terminal | — |
| **any other (state × event) pair** | — | **ILLEGAL ⇒ typed error, journalled** | — |

## Section A — dispatcher-initiated effect machine

| State | Event | Next | `expected_base_oid` effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| — | `prepare(movement_id, subject)` | PREPARED | — |
| PREPARED | `submit` | SUBMITTED | — |
| PREPARED | `submit_outcome_unknown` (transport failed before any outcome existed) | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | — |
| PREPARED | `crash_recovery` / `later_observation` / `move_to_hold` | HELD | — |
| SUBMITTED | `observe_effect(new_oid)` ∧ parent pair == (base_oid, head_oid) | EFFECT_OBSERVED | — |
| SUBMITTED | `observe_effect(new_oid)` ∧ parent-pair mismatch | HELD | — |
| SUBMITTED | `observe_reject` | REJECTED_NO_EFFECT | — |
| SUBMITTED | `timeout_unknown` | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | — |
| SUBMITTED | `crash_recovery` / `later_observation` | HELD | — |
| EFFECT_OBSERVED | `match_in_memory(movement_id)` | EXPLAINED | `:= new_oid` |
| REJECTED_NO_EFFECT | `match_in_memory(movement_id)` (cause recorded) | EXPLAINED — never silently terminal | — |
| OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | `later_observation` / `crash_recovery` | HELD | — |
| HELD | `operator_reconcile(accepting disposition)` | RECONCILED(d) | per disposition |
| HELD | `operator_reconcile(REJECT_RESTORE_HOLD)` | **HELD** (assessment recorded; further reconcile legal) | none |
| RECONCILED(d) | `operator_reconcile(d)` — same d | RECONCILED(d) — identity (idempotent replay) | none |
| RECONCILED(d) | `operator_reconcile(d′ ≠ d)` | ILLEGAL ⇒ typed error | — |
| EXPLAINED · RECONCILED | any other event | terminal — ILLEGAL | — |
| **any other (state × event) pair** | — | **ILLEGAL ⇒ typed error, journalled — never a silent no-op** | — |
